_status: PROPOSAL ONLY / NOT APPLIED TO AWS. Add this one statement to the existing SiteProof-AWSB-ProbeBoundary policy (private package AWS_B_IAM_20261112/probe-boundary-policy.json, not modified here). Replace the placeholders. Without it the probe role's sns:Publish is cut off by the boundary and every notification fails (the heartbeat then goes silent and the aggregate alarm fires).
_unchanged: DynamoDB (PutItem, UpdateItem on siteproof-b-*-runs with LeadingKeys) and Logs statements stay as they are: the claim now returns HEAD with ReturnValues ALL_NEW, which needs UpdateItem only, not GetItem/Query. EMF metrics need no cloudwatch:PutMetricData (CloudWatch Logs extracts them).
_operator_side: Creating infra/aws_b/health.json needs cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm / DescribeAlarms / DeleteAlarms on the one heartbeat alarm name, and the stopper (if ever deployed) needs cloudwatch:DisableAlarmActions on that alarm only. The SNS topic policy must still allow cloudwatch.amazonaws.com (heartbeat alarm); the probe role publishes through IAM, not through the topic policy.
